cookie_banner_desc: We use strictly necessary storage to operate this site (§ 25 (2) TDDDG). Optional preferences, analytics, and external media are activated only with your explicit prior consent (§ 25 (1) TDDDG, Art. 6 (1)(a) GDPR) and can be revoked at any time.
cookie_cat_analytics_desc: Helps us understand aggregated page performance and reading patterns using pseudonymous metrics once consented.
cookie_cat_marketing_desc: Enables loading embedded third-party content (videos, maps, interactive widgets) that may transmit your IP address to external providers.
cookie_cat_necessary_desc: Required for secure page delivery and storing your privacy consent decision and explicitly requested color theme without tracking.
cookie_cat_preferences_desc: Allows remembering optional interface settings such as saved filter states and comfort preferences across visits.
cookie_item_analytics_purpose: Stores pseudonymous session and performance measurement identifiers.
cookie_item_consent_purpose: Stores your TDDDG/GDPR consent status, version, and audit ID.
cookie_item_marketing_purpose: Unblocks third-party media embeds and stores external provider preferences.
cookie_item_prefs_purpose: Persists optional UI comfort preferences across sessions.
cookie_item_theme_purpose: Remembers your explicitly selected light or dark color mode.
cookie_modal_intro: Choose which optional device storage and processing categories you permit. Unselected categories remain blocked by default, and you can update or withdraw your decision at any time with future effect (Art. 7 (3) GDPR).
home_spec_i18n_desc: Compile-time TypeScript dictionaries across {count} configured locales with zero client bundle bloat.
home_spec_pages_desc: Canvas, contained, and editorial page layouts with optional heroes or bespoke Astro templates.
home_spec_rtl_desc: 100% CSS logical property layout with automatic mirroring for Persian and Arabic scripts.
site_description: Production-grade, multi-lingual Astro v7 starter template with native RTL and LTR support.
